title: Remove sump/oil pan, pickup, oil pump and scavenge pumps

notices.text: Expect the sump to have been sealed with a heavy hand of Loctite 5900 — scrape it carefully and do not gouge the aluminium sealing face, and do not let scrapings fall into the case. Inspect the oil pump gears for scoring and measure gear-to-housing clearance. Check the oil pump drive — the OEM drive is a known weak link and a chromoly replacement is a sensible upgrade while you are in here. Inspect the pickup screen for the same debris you found in the filter.

steps.text: Remove sump/oil pan, pickup, oil pump and scavenge pumps.

fasteners.name: Oil pan / sump bolts
fasteners.note: Low value into aluminium; spiral sequence from the centre out.

sources.ref: WSM Gr.1 Part 1 (M96/01 edition) p.1-1 (oil pan to crankcase)
